title: The integral compact-support construction interface
statement: In the module-object derived categories and standing separated finite-type schemes of [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting], retain the compactification composites, total pullbacks, actual adjunction mates and normalization equations previously attached to the integral compact-support construction theorem. Package their preservation, comparison, composition and coherence clauses as the same predicates. This is an interface extraction: no functor, coefficient predicate, normalization, universe or quantified hypothesis changes.

proof.text: Instantiate the existing two-factor exchange data with the compactification open extension, proper pushforward, literal proper pullback and inverse open exchange. Specify the source scheme of the proper pullback explicitly as the base-changed compactification. Identity-component associators identify the map with its old formula. Project the proved isomorphism API for the component theorem.

Cache the canonical condensed coefficient-ring MonObj instance under a semireducible name, and prove its commutativity by unfolding that name and applying the existing canonical commutativity instance. Register the helpers only locally when elaborating the concrete integral compact-support theorem.

proof_origin.place: The proper/open base-change composite and its elementary component API.

lean.note: N3: retain the same proper/open exchange; construct it using the existing two-factor exchange-data structure and expose its proved componentwise invertibility API. Identity-component associators are omitted. All existing signatures remain unchanged. The two coefficient helpers name the existing canonical multiplication and prove its commutativity; no new ring data or choice is introduced.
